messages:
ryan: Heads-up — noticed a spike in Prometheus scrape latency for per-GPU metrics after the us-east deploy. p50->p95 widened and ingestion/storage costs jumped. Thinking we should trial switching the DCGM exporter to a light-weight eBPF sampler for kernel counters and reduce per-device scrape from 5s -> 15s. Any objections?

sree: Do we have a clear SLO for per-GPU metrics latency/availability? We should tie any sampling change to SLO impact. Current alert fires when 5% of GPUs miss 3 scrapes.

mona: Current billing shows per-device TSDB cardinality is the main cost driver. Reducing scrape freq helps but we also need to dedupe labels (pci address variants, ephemeral UUID labels). Also concerned about missing short-lived spikes that matter for autoscaler signals.

oli: Can we instead aggregate on-node and expose a single per-node metric like gpu_utilization_percent? That would cut series count dramatically and preserve a useful signal.

ryan: Proposal: two-pronged approach — (1) on-node aggregation for non-critical high-cardinality metrics, (2) eBPF short-sampling for kernel-level counters and keep DCGM for detailed per-device metrics only on demand. Roll via canary in eu-west-1 (lower cost pool) first.

deploy-bot: Rolling canary job gpu-metrics-ebpf-canary -> eu-west-1 (10% nodes). Started 2072003500.

lisa: +1 for canary. Also add Prometheus recording rules to synthesize per-node totals so dashboards don't break. Quick local scrape config I used for testing:
```
- job_name: 'gpu_onnode'
  metrics_path: /metrics
  static_configs:
  - targets: ['localhost:9101']
  scrape_interval: 15s
  relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_node_name]
    target_label: node
```

sree: For SLOs: propose we keep a synthetic test that emits a known pattern on a test GPU and assert ingestion within 2x scrape_interval for 99.9% over the week. If canary breaches thresholds, auto-rollback.

mona: Also need to update alerting thresholds: current 'gpu_missing_scrapes' uses count >3. For the canary window change to >5 and add a rate-based alert to catch persistent outages vs transient misses.

oli: I'll prepare a kustomize patch to add an aggregation sidecar and relabel rules to drop pci_bus and ephemeral labels from exported metrics. ETA ~2h.

ryan: Thanks all — I'll monitor storage delta and TSDB OOMs. Follow-ups: oli -> kustomize patch, lisa -> recording rules PR, sree -> SLO test harness, mona -> alert tweaks. Ping in this thread when PRs are ready. :rocket:
